verdict.summary: No incident; traffic flowing normally on multi-lane freeway under clear skies.
verdict.details: Forward dashcam view traveling on a multi-lane Southern California freeway toward San Diego on a clear sunny day. Cars, SUVs, pickups and semi-trucks move steadily in both directions. Concrete medians, overpasses, green guide signs and trees visible. No crash, debris, stopped vehicles or emergency presence seen.
